latest_draw_update_policy.source_name: Official South African National Lottery results

provenance_qualified_operational_state.purpose: Permit operational XTRA rows independently corroborated from public result histories to enter the ledger when the configured official source is unavailable or stale, while retaining explicit pending-official-verification flags.
provenance_qualified_operational_state.rule: Do not strip pending_official_source_verification flags or represent these rows as official-source verified until the configured official source is successfully checked.

notes: The active HEPS XTRA lane begins with the South African PowerBall XTRA series on 2026-06-02.
No pre-June 2026 PowerBall Plus/XTRA history may enter active XTRA state, priors, recency, HLR/VVD, candidate scores, or validation denominators.
Main PowerBall learned state and parameters are not transferred into XTRA.
Rows through 2026-08-21 retain their original project provenance.

Rows 2026-08-25 through 2026-09-15 were cross-checked against two independent nonofficial XTRA result archives: za.national-lottery.com and lottery.co.za. Dated za.national-lottery.com pages also supplied machine names where recorded.
The ledger is now date-complete for every Tuesday/Friday XTRA draw from 2026-06-02 through 2026-09-15 inclusive (31 rows, draw ids 1725-1755).
Official Sizekhaya/National Lottery source verification remains pending for rows carrying the pending_official_source_verification flag; do not mislabel the independent archives as official.
Future updates should read the local ledger first and follow the configured official-source policy for the newest missing draw whenever the official result endpoint is accessible.
